review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-25. CH2 + HSS product exit: two CH2 frontier directions plus the HSS radical, three electrons in three orbitals. Natural 20-22 retain that span at the actual L2 product endpoint and 30 angstrom in both bases. Use this exit-specific checkpoint and atom map, rather than the inner C-S homolysis geometry. Selected from native occupations and AO coefficients, not an energy-window rule. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital, root and connectivity checks. State averaging is optimization support; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Direct CASPT2-F12 uses avdz-f12/avtz-f12 CBS power 3.7 and the separate 30 angstrom asymptote. Outer dividing surfaces use fragment COM separation; the correction scan uses the mapped interfragment anchor of the saved product complex. Preserve both explicitly configured grids and the product-side geometry.
